description: Defines how tasks are delegated between departments, approval chains, and hand-off protocols.
task_lifecycle: INTAKE      → Task received, routed via router.js
BRIEFED     → Lead department receives brief and loads system-prompt
IN-PROGRESS → Department works the task using its workflows
REVIEW      → Output reviewed against brand-strategy guidelines
HANDOFF     → Output passed to next department if collaboration needed

copywriting → shopify-cro.note: CRO implements copy into Liquid section and optimizes layout

creative-direction → copywriting.note: Copywriter writes to the visual direction, not the other way around

brand-strategy → all.note: All departments re-calibrate after a brand-strategy output

tiktok-growth → shopify-cro.note: TikTok Creative Director writes brief; CRO builds in Liquid

paid-ads → copywriting.note: Copywriter delivers primary text, headline, description per format

retention-email → copywriting.note: Copywriter fills email body copy to flow skeleton

approval_gates.description: All copy output must pass brand voice check before delivery
All Shopify changes must pass CRO readiness before going live
All visual assets must align with creative direction before use

P1_immediate.description: Revenue-impacting issues — site down, checkout broken, drop launch

P2_urgent.description: Active campaign issues — ad copy needed, TikTok video going live

P3_standard.description: Standard deliverables — product copy, email flows, creative briefs

P4_evergreen.description: Non-urgent — brand strategy, documentation, process refinement
